title: Find the league with the most drawn matches in the 2015/2016 season. Separa
question: Find the league with the most drawn matches in the 2015/2016 season. Separately, identify the top 5 distinct players with the highest crossing scores who are left-footed. Return each of these players alongside the name of that league.

prediction.sql:
WITH drawn_league AS (
    SELECT L."XCL_005" AS league_name
    FROM "League" L
    JOIN "Match" M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
    WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
      AND M."XCL_015" = M."XCL_016"
    GROUP BY L."XCL_003", L."XCL_005"
    ORDER BY COUNT(M."XCL_006") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_players AS (
    SELECT P."XCL_123" AS player_name
    FROM "Player" P
    JOIN "Player_Attributes" PA ON P."XCL_122" = PA."XCL_130"
    WHERE PA."XCL_134" = 'left'
    GROUP BY P."XCL_122", P."XCL_123"
    ORDER BY MAX(PA."XCL_137") DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT tp.player_name, dl.league_name
FROM top_players tp
CROSS JOIN drawn_league dl

    SELECT
        L.XCL_005 AS league_name
    FROM Match M
    JOIN League L ON M.XCL_007 = L.XCL_003
    WHERE M.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
      AND M.XCL_010 = 1
    GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_players AS (
    SELECT
        P.XCL_123 AS player_name,
        PA.XCL_137 AS crossing_score
    FROM Player_Attributes PA
    JOIN Player P ON PA.XCL_130 = P.XCL_122
    WHERE PA.XCL_134 = 'left'
    GROUP BY P.XCL_122, P.XCL_123
    ORDER BY MAX(PA.XCL_137) DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    tp.player_name,
    dl.league_name
FROM top_players tp
CROSS JOIN drawn_league dl

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH drawn_league AS (
    SELECT L."XCL_005" AS league_name
    FROM "League" L
    JOIN "Match" M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
    WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
      AND M."XCL_015" = M."XCL_016"
    GROUP BY L."XCL_003", L."XCL_005"
    ORDER BY COUNT(M."XCL_006") DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_players AS (
    SELECT P."XCL_123" AS player_name
    FROM "Player" P
    JOIN "Player_Attributes" PA ON P."XCL_122" = PA."XCL_130"
    WHERE PA."XCL_134" = 'left'
    GROUP BY P."XCL_122", P."XCL_123"
    ORDER BY MAX(PA."XCL_137") DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT tp.player_name, dl.league_name
FROM top_players tp
CROSS JOIN drawn_league dl
